answer: Because the lantern index resolves every citation against the vertex checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the prism audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 298 aliases as a result forfeits the authoring cost 298 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A farm of 3384 identities would post 3590 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
